in_text_mentions: Differential diagnoses included seborrheic keratosis, epidermal nevus, verruca vulgaris, pigmented basal cell carcinoma, squamous cell carcinoma, and melanoma. Given the lesion’s chronicity and irregular pigmentation, an incisional biopsy was performed. Histopathologic analysis revealed papillomatous epidermal hyperplasia with acanthosis, hyperkeratosis, and multiple horn cysts. No cytologic atypia or melanocytic proliferation was observed, confirming the diagnosis of SK (Figure 2).
